analysis.headline: Sells & Shares Your Data
analysis.quote: Under these state privacy laws “sale” means certain scenarios in which Wyze has disclosed Personal Information to third parties in exchange for valuable or monetary consideration.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Facial Data
analysis.quote: In jurisdictions where we offer Friendly Faces, if you enable Friendly Faces with your Cam Plus or Cam Protect Service, we collect and record facial images and generate and store measurements to create personal information relating to those images (“Facial Data”), which could be considered biometric information or biometric data in some jurisdictions.

analysis.headline: Trains AI with Your Content
analysis.quote: If you consent to allow us to use your information for purposes of training our models or algorithms or improve our products and services, we will use your videos and the descriptions created by Descriptive Alert to develop or improve our algorithms, models, and/or machine learning technologies.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Health Data
analysis.quote: In connection with specific Devices, you may provide us with additional personal information, such as the name you choose for your Device, or, when setting up or using the Wyze Watch, Wyze Band or Wyze Scale, your birth year, height, weight, gender, occupation, and personal fitness goals.

analysis.headline: Keeps Your Data Long-Term
analysis.quote: If you close your account, we will delete your account data within 180 days; otherwise, we will delete your account data after three years of inactivity.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Precise Location
analysis.quote: With your consent, we may also collect information about the precise location of your mobile device in connection with your use of our mobile apps.

analysis.headline: Cross-Context Ad Targeting
analysis.quote: “Sharing” in this context means that we make available or otherwise disclose your information to third parties for cross-context behavioral advertising, such as targeting of advertising to you based on your Personal Information obtained from your activity across businesses, websites, apps, and services other than our Services.

analysis.headline: Nondiscrimination for Your Rights
analysis.quote: We will not discriminate against you for exercising your privacy rights.
